alt: A line of students holding downward dog on mats across a wide studio floor
subject: A line of about ten students holds downward-facing dog on mats laid in rows across the studio, with wooden blocks beside several mats and one person standing at the back of the room.

alt: Students standing with arms stretched overhead in a row across a wide studio floor
subject: Students stand on their mats with arms stretched overhead and palms together in a row across the studio, a man in a peach t-shirt doing the same in the near foreground with his back to the camera.

alt: A full class holding downward-facing dog on mats while a teacher watches from the side of the hall.
subject: The whole class holds downward-facing dog on mats across the room while a teacher stands observing at the right.

alt: Group seated on mats facing the front of a studio with ropes and ceiling slings
subject: A wide view of the studio with roughly a dozen people seated on mats facing the front, rope wall and red ceiling slings above.

alt: Wide view of a seated group on mats in a studio with rope wall and windows
subject: The same seated group from a slightly wider angle, mats spread across the reddish-brown floor with windows along the right wall.

alt: Wide studio interior with participants seated on mats beneath ceiling slings and fans
subject: A landscape view of the full studio: seated participants on coloured mats, rope wall at the left, ceiling slings and fans overhead, a screen at the right.

alt: Participant kneeling on a purple mat in the foreground of a studio class
subject: A participant in orange sits back on her heels on a purple mat in the foreground while the rest of the group sits facing the front of the room.

alt: Participant moving on a mat in the foreground while a class sits facing the front
subject: The same foreground participant a moment later, one hand lowered to the mat, with the seated group and rope wall behind her.

alt: Cropped view of a dancer's crimson drape and bare feet in a wide braced stance.
subject: A headless crop of a dancer's torso, crimson drape and bare feet in a wide braced stance on a pale painted floor.

alt: Three dancers stand with palms joined at the chest in front of a painted mural wall.
subject: Three dancers stand apart on the painted floor with palms joined at the chest, the mural wall, a banner and venue equipment spread across the wide frame.

alt: Four speakers seated in wooden chairs along a white wall hung with printed charts.
subject: Four panellists sit in wooden chairs in a row along a white wall hung with printed charts, a small round table with a bottle and a plant between them.

alt: Covered hall with red roof trusses and skylights above a line of people practising on mats
subject: A wide view of a covered hall with red roof trusses and skylights above a line of practitioners bending on mats.

alt: Wide view of a group practising with arms raised under a high steel roof
subject: Wide view of a large hall with a high steel roof where a spread-out group stands on mats with arms raised, watched by people seated on chairs at the left.

alt: Class folding forward in two rows down a plant-lined hall, daylight through the skylight roof.
subject: Two rows of practitioners fold forward over mats down the length of a plant-lined hall, with daylight entering through the skylight roof behind them.

alt: Students seated on mats in forward bends across a wide open hall with chairs along the wall
subject: Students sit on mats in forward bends across a wide open hall with white chairs along the wall and a light stand at the right.

alt: A practitioner balances on one leg with palms together at the chest during a class.
subject: A practitioner stands balanced on one leg with the other foot at the inner thigh and palms pressed together at the chest, looking towards the camera.

alt: A practitioner balances on one leg with both arms lifted overhead in an outdoor class.
subject: A practitioner in a blue shirt balances on one leg with both arms lifted overhead, with blurred white chairs and green painted floor behind.

alt: Kneeling classical dancer with one arm raised in a hand gesture, mid-performance.
subject: The dancer kneels low on the painted stage circle with one arm raised overhead in a hand gesture and the other at her waist, her crimson drape spread across the floor, against a plain white wall.

alt: Classical dancer kneeling low, arm extended overhead, crimson drape spread on the floor.
subject: A frame from the same sequence with the raised arm further extended and the head turned to follow the hand, the drape fanned out on the pale stage floor.

alt: Dancer kneeling with a raised hand near her head, eyes following the gesture.
subject: The kneeling dancer holds a raised hand close beside her head with her gaze following it and her free hand at her hip, the branded medallion on the wall behind her out of focus.

alt: Dancer balanced on one leg mid-step, her drape swinging, banner behind.
subject: The dancer is caught mid-step balanced on one leg with the other knee lifted, one hand raised beside her face and the crimson drape swinging out, in front of the printed banner.

alt: Dancer standing mid-phrase with both hands in a gesture, weight on one leg.
subject: The dancer stands with weight on one leg, both hands held in a gesture in front of her chest and her gaze directed off to one side, the printed banner behind her.

alt: Dancer with both arms raised overhead, fingers curled in a mudra, leg turned out
subject: The dancer raises both arms overhead with fingers curled in a mudra, one leg turned out, in front of the mural and a hanging banner.

alt: A teacher leans in and holds a hand above a student's back to adjust a plank position.
subject: A teacher leans over a student and holds his hand just above the student's back to correct the line of a plank position.

alt: A barefoot man on a green stool talks to a small group seated on the floor beside him.
subject: A man in a light blue kurta sits barefoot on a green plastic stool talking, with listeners seated on the concrete floor at the right and an air cooler, shelving and a hanging canopy behind him.

alt: Four panellists on wooden chairs on a green stage before a wall with a painted tree and mandala.
subject: Four panellists sit on wooden chairs on a green-painted stage beside a small table holding a plant and a glass, in front of a white wall with a painted tree, a circular mandala emblem and a colour-wheel chart.

alt: One of four seated panellists speaks into a handheld microphone while the others listen.
subject: The same four panellists on stage, the man at the right speaking into a handheld microphone while the other three sit listening.

alt: Framed paintings on a wooden rack beneath a tree with a moulded face on its trunk
subject: A wooden rack of small framed paintings stands under a tree whose trunk carries a moulded white face, with leaves and a purple drape around it.

alt: Two framed child portrait paintings hanging on cords against a white draped wall
subject: Two framed child portrait paintings hang on jute cords in front of a white draped fabric wall.

alt: Framed portrait of an elderly man above a wooden desk with a mantel clock and brass objects
subject: A framed portrait painting of an elderly man hangs on a dark curtain above a wooden desk holding a mantel clock, a brass lamp and small objects.

alt: Quiet exhibition corner with a framed portrait on a dark curtain above an antique desk
subject: A wider view of the same display corner: the framed portrait on a dark curtain, the wooden writing desk beneath it, and a large expanse of curtain to the right.

alt: Vintage blue truck cab mounted above bookshelves as a cafe interior installation.
subject: The front cab of a vintage blue truck is mounted above a wall of bookshelves inside the cafe, with a globe light above it and a framed sign below.
